summary: EXP-450 P2 replacement_html_block had a 3rd paragraph asserting magnetic field decay is 1/r-type (or 1/r^2 in spherically symmetric cases). This is wrong: magnetic dipole far-field is 1/r^3 (Griffiths §5.4 / Jackson §5.6). EXP-567 consolidation deleted the entire 3rd paragraph in-place (paragraphs 1-2 carry the topology+magnitude argument; paragraph 4 frames why foundational). EXP-450 file status flipped to ready-for-integration. Close as fixed-by EXP-567.
